checklist.title: Documents for {exam}
checklist.intro: We'll go one by one, about a minute each. Your files stay on this phone.
checklist.restored: Welcome back. Your progress was saved on this device.
checklist.noPersist: Private mode: your progress won't be saved if you close this page.
checklist.staleNotice: The official sizes changed since your last visit. We are re-fitting your files.
checklist.staleDone: Your files were re-fitted to the new sizes.

live.title: Photo is taken live in the form
live.body: You don't need to upload a photo for {exam}. Here's how to get the live photo right:
live.alsoTitle: A live photo is also taken in the form
live.alsoBody: Upload your photo here, and be ready for a live photo in the {exam} form too.
live.tipsToggle: How to get the live photo right

variant.dualBody: {exam} needs one signature in Hindi and one in English, uploaded separately. This step is: {doc}.
variant.tripleBody: {exam} wants three signatures, one below the other, on one white sheet. Keep all three inside the box in one photo.

upload.title: Add your {doc}
upload.promise: We'll make it exactly the size {exam} asks for.

how.photo: Take a clear photo of your face against a plain light wall, in good light.
how.signature: Sign on plain white paper with a black pen. Take the photo from straight above, in good light.
how.thumb: Put your left thumb impression on plain white paper. Take the photo from straight above, in good light.
how.declaration: Write the declaration on plain white paper. Take the photo from straight above, in good light.
how.certificate: Take a photo of each page, or choose a PDF. We join them into one PDF.
how.other: Take a clear photo of the document from straight above, in good light.

example.title: What a good one looks like

signature.good: Black pen, plain white paper, fills the box
signature.bad: Blue pen, lined paper, shadow, too small

photo.good: Plain light background, face in the centre, even light
photo.bad: Cap, busy background, shadow on the face

thumb.good: One clear press, ridges visible, inside the box
thumb.bad: Smudged, too much ink, pressed twice

crop.title: Adjust your {doc}
crop.canvasLabel: Crop area. Drag to move, pinch to zoom. Arrow keys move, plus and minus zoom, R rotates.
crop.hintPhoto: Fit your face inside the oval. Keep your eyes on the yellow line.
crop.hintInk: The ink should fill at least 80% of the yellow dashed box.
crop.hintFree: Drag to move. Pinch or use the slider to zoom.
crop.cleanupHint: Makes the paper pure white and the ink dark.
crop.fitting: Making it the right size for {exam}…

nameDate.title: Name and date on the photo
nameDate.hint: {exam} wants your name and the date printed below your face. We add it inside the final size.
nameDate.name: Your name

declaration.title: Print a trace sheet
declaration.body: The declaration must be in your own handwriting. Print this sheet, write the text on the lines, then take a photo of it.
declaration.name: Your full name
declaration.toVerify: Check this text against the official notice before you write it.

certificate.title: Add your {doc}
certificate.body: Add photos or PDFs of every page. We combine them into one PDF of {range}.
certificate.empty: Add at least one page first.

result.title: {doc} is ready

warnings.PADDED: Invisible padding was added to reach the minimum size.
warnings.GRAIN: A tiny invisible grain was added to reach the minimum size.
warnings.BLURRED: A slight blur was used to get under the maximum size.
warnings.PASSES_ONLY_1024: Inside the range when 1 KB = 1024 bytes (most portals).
warnings.PASSES_ONLY_1000: Inside the range only when 1 KB = 1000 bytes.
warnings.DOWNSCALED: The picture was made a little smaller to fit the maximum size.
warnings.LETTERBOXED: White space was added to match the required shape.
warnings.COVER_CROPPED: The edges were trimmed to match the required shape.

result.verdictSub: Right shape, right file size, right file type.

fix.background: The background is too dark. Take a new photo against a plain light wall.
fix.size: The file could not be made the right size. Crop a little tighter, or use a clearer photo.
fix.pdf: The PDF is outside the allowed size. Change the pages: remove a page or use lighter scans.
fix.other: This file does not match the {exam} rules yet. Try a different photo.

result.nextUpload: Next: on the {body} website, upload {file} in the {doc} box.

summary.title: Your {exam} files
summary.intro: {n} of {total} files are ready, sized to the {exam} rules.
summary.nextZip: Tap the button at the bottom to download all files together, in one ZIP file.
summary.nextOpen: Open the ZIP from Downloads or the Files app to see each file. Or download them one by one below.
summary.nextOne: Tap the button at the bottom to download your file.
summary.nextUpload: Upload them on the {body} website, each file in its own box:
summary.nextUploadOne: Upload it on the {body} website, in its own box:

startOver.title: Start over?
startOver.body: This removes all your {exam} files from this device.

feedback.question: Did the {exam} portal accept your files?
feedback.thanks: Thank you! This helps other candidates.
